queries: SELECT id,status::text,"offersCloseAt" AS closes_at,"awardedAt" AS awarded_at,"awardedOfferId" AS awarded_id,"updatedAt" AS updated_at FROM "SpotRequirement" WHERE id LIKE 'uat-invalid-fee-%-20261002' UNION ALL SELECT id,status::text,"biddingClosesAt","awardedAt","awardedBidId","updatedAt" FROM "Listing" WHERE id LIKE 'uat-invalid-fee-%-20261002' UNION ALL SELECT id,status::text,"responseClosesAt","awardedAt","awardedResponseId","updatedAt" FROM "Tender" WHERE id LIKE 'uat-invalid-fee-%-20261002' ORDER BY id

SELECT 'spot' AS kind,"spotRequirementId" AS source_id,id,status FROM "SpotOffer" WHERE "spotRequirementId" LIKE 'uat-invalid-fee-%-20261002' UNION ALL SELECT 'marketplace',"listingId",id,'PRESENT' FROM "Bid" WHERE "listingId" LIKE 'uat-invalid-fee-%-20261002' UNION ALL SELECT 'tender',"tenderId",id,status FROM "TenderResponse" WHERE "tenderId" LIKE 'uat-invalid-fee-%-20261002' ORDER BY source_id,id

SELECT 'spot-overlap' AS fixture, CASE WHEN is_called THEN last_value ELSE 0 END AS hits FROM froto_uat_config_spot_overlap_20261002 UNION ALL SELECT 'spot-payer' AS fixture, CASE WHEN is_called THEN last_value ELSE 0 END AS hits FROM froto_uat_config_spot_payer_20261002 UNION ALL SELECT 'marketplace-overlap' AS fixture, CASE WHEN is_called THEN last_value ELSE 0 END AS hits FROM froto_uat_config_marketplace_overlap_20261002 UNION ALL SELECT 'marketplace-payer' AS fixture, CASE WHEN is_called THEN last_value ELSE 0 END AS hits FROM froto_uat_config_marketplace_payer_20261002 UNION ALL SELECT 'tender-overlap' AS fixture, CASE WHEN is_called THEN last_value ELSE 0 END AS hits FROM froto_uat_config_tender_overlap_20261002 UNION ALL SELECT 'tender-payer' AS fixture, CASE WHEN is_called THEN last_value ELSE 0 END AS hits FROM froto_uat_config_tender_payer_20261002
artifactQuery: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM "Job" WHERE COALESCE("spotRequirementId","listingId","tenderId") LIKE 'uat-invalid-fee-%-20261002') AS jobs,(SELECT count(*) FROM "JobEvent" e JOIN "Job" j ON j.id=e."jobId" WHERE COALESCE(j."spotRequirementId",j."listingId",j."tenderId") LIKE 'uat-invalid-fee-%-20261002') AS events,(SELECT count(*) FROM "TransactionFee" WHERE COALESCE(metadata->>'spotRequirementId',metadata->>'listingId',metadata->>'tenderId') LIKE 'uat-invalid-fee-%-20261002') AS fees,(SELECT count(*) FROM "Notification" WHERE COALESCE(metadata->>'spotRequirementId',metadata->>'listingId',metadata->>'tenderId') LIKE 'uat-invalid-fee-%-20261002') AS notifications
